source: Cypher Reference Document: Cleric Abilities — Divine Radiance (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License
note: Divine Radiance — Blessing. spell. A short-range target gains an asset to one action before their next ten-minute-or-longer recovery; Effort adds two targets. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Cypher Reference Document: Cleric Abilities — Divine Radiance (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License
note: Divine Radiance — Turn Undead. spell. Attacks up to five nearby undead of level 2 or less, making affected creatures flee for their next turn; Effort adds targets and raises the level limit, while tier 3 can stop their actions instead. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Cypher Reference Document: Cleric Abilities — Healing Hand (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License
note: Healing Hand. spell. Touch reduces one wound by one severity step, with an escalating Intellect cost that resets after recovery; an NPC recipient regains 5 health. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Cypher Reference Document: Druid Abilities — Friend to Small Creatures (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License
note: Friend to Small Creatures. spell. [verb bind; also needs plant-or-creature-target] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Cypher Reference Document: Druid Abilities — Seeds of Fury (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License
note: Seeds of Fury. spell. A successful attack sends ignited seeds at a target within long range, dealing 3 damage and burning for 1 damage per round until doused or the druid recovers. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Cypher Reference Document: Mage Abilities — Blast (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License

source: Cypher Reference Document: Mage Abilities — Mage Armor (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License

source: Cypher Reference Document: Mage Abilities — Prepare Spell (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License

source: Cypher Reference Document: Necromancer Abilities — Basic Necromancy (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License
note: Basic Necromancy. spell. [verb transform; also needs construct-upkeep] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Cypher Reference Document: Necromancer Abilities — Drain Life (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License
note: Drain Life. spell. A successful Intellect attack sends a tendril to short range, dealing 2 damage to a living target and healing a minor wound on the necromancer or a nearby ally; tier 3 Effort can raise damage to 5 and heal a moderate wound. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Cypher Reference Document: Necromancer Abilities — Tribulation (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License
note: Tribulation. spell. Attacks up to five nearby undead, demons, or similar creatures of level 2 or less, making each affected foe flee or lose its next turn; Effort raises the level limit or specifies another one-round action. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Cypher Reference Document: Paladin Abilities — Holy Succor (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License
note: Holy Succor. spell. A nearby ally with at least three moderate wounds or one major wound gains one free level of Effort each round for an attack or defense until healed or taking a ten-minute recovery; repeated uses increase the Intellect cost until recovery. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Cypher Reference Document: Paladin Abilities — Sacred Smite (cypher-rd#002); licence Cypher Open License
note: Sacred Smite. spell. For 2 Intellect, attacks against a chosen visible creature deal 1 extra damage until another creature is attacked; against undead, demons, or similar foes, a hit instead can deal 2 extra damage or make the foe flee for one turn. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Cypher Reference Document: Priest Abilities — Retribution (cypher-rd#003); licence Cypher Open License

source: Cypher Reference Document: Sorcerer Abilities — Open Inner Eye: Mindslice (cypher-rd#003); licence Cypher Open License

source: Cypher Reference Document: Wizard Abilities — tier 1 (cypher-rd#004); licence Cypher Open License
